header.title: Promo Codes
header.intro: Upload the discount codes from your store, or let POWR mint them. Members draw one from the pool when they redeem.
header.deliveryApi: You deliver codes via the API — codes loaded here act as a fallback buffer if your integration is ever unavailable at redemption time.
header.deliveryShopify: You deliver codes via Shopify — codes loaded here act as a fallback buffer if your integration is ever unavailable at redemption time.

loadError.title: Couldn't load your rewards
loadError.body: Your code pools are safe — the list just didn't come back this time.

empty.title: No digital rewards yet
empty.body: Code pools hang off a digital reward — create one and its pool appears here.

stages.pickHint: Choose which reward these codes unlock — each reward keeps its own pool.
stages.loadHintDry: The pool has run dry — every code is used or expired. Add a fresh batch so members can keep redeeming.
stages.loadHintEmpty: Generate a batch right here or upload the codes from your store — either takes under a minute.
stages.redeemHintLive: POWR hands a code to each member automatically when they redeem — nothing else to set up.
stages.redeemHintReady: Codes are ready — once this reward goes live in the app, members draw from the pool automatically.
stages.done: This reward is live — POWR hands a code to each member automatically. Reconcile used codes or top up the pool anytime below.

format.title: Code Format
format.placeholder: Enter one example code to define the format — e.g. POWR-BRAND-ABC123
format.invalid: Must start with POWR- and contain only A–Z, 0–9, and dashes
format.defaultHint: Leave blank to use the default POWR-XXXX-XXXXXX (6-char) format

upload.title: Upload Your Codes
upload.pastePlaceholder: Paste codes or drop a CSV — Status + Deleted at columns are respected automatically

reconcile.title: Reconcile store redemptions
reconcile.body: Paste or upload the codes your store reports as redeemed. POWR marks only codes already assigned to a member as used; unassigned, expired, and unknown codes stay unchanged.
reconcile.placeholder: Paste a code list or a CSV with a Code column
reconcile.confirm_one: Reconcile {{count}} store redemption? Only codes already assigned by POWR can be marked used.
reconcile.confirm_other: Reconcile {{count}} store redemptions? Only codes already assigned by POWR can be marked used.

confirm.all: Set expiry to {{date}} for all codes in this pool?
confirm.available: Set expiry to {{date}} for available codes in this pool?
confirm.reserved: Set expiry to {{date}} for reserved codes in this pool?
confirm.used: Set expiry to {{date}} for used codes in this pool?
confirm.expired: Set expiry to {{date}} for expired codes in this pool?
